::: {.callout-note}
## Why there is no separate origins chapter
This archive does **not** maintain a separate origins narrative. The pre-CSIL community-living context that can be sourced today is already written on the [Creekview](creekview.qmd) page, mainly from [Haw 1989](../sources/1989-haw-special-housing-needs.qmd) and the 1984–86 Hansard sittings. A free-standing “independent living in British Columbia” chapter would invent breadth the sources do not support.
:::

## Why the context lives on Creekview

When this archive was first planned, this page was reserved for disability-led independent-living and community-living advocacy before Creekview, ECPM, and CSIL. The earliest public record in the catalogue that we have actually read is [Hansard, 24 February 1984](../sources/1984-hansard-mowat-creekview.qmd), which already describes the planned Creekview move. [Haw 1989](../sources/1989-haw-special-housing-needs.qmd) is a Canadian Paraplegic Association official’s later overview of 1970s–early-1980s housing and Long Term Care. The Creekview chapter already summarizes that sequence and labels it as a later overview, not a 1970s file from the time.

No public primary source from before February 1984 has been catalogued here that would support a separate origins chapter without repeating Creekview or guessing a national independent-living history.

## What this page is not

- A placeholder waiting for a future general history
- A claim that Creekview *is* the origin of CSIL
- A substitute for the [ECPM](ecpm.qmd) or [CSIL design and pilot](csil-pilot.qmd) chapters

Creekview still does **not** treat the 1980s project as a proven predecessor of ECPM or CSIL. That relationship remains an open question on the Creekview and ECPM pages.
